changes.title: Conga not leashed
items: After winning an island, the conga line follows you without ever joining your sigil stack

changes.title: Babies scatter far
items: In a fight your babies scatter right off the screen (about 55 m away) instead of hanging around you, and come back into line once it's over

changes.title: Ko happy
items: Knocked out, the animals you were carrying now turn happy where they stand instead of being left at sigils: they head home and defend their own area, and you can pick up their runes to take them back
